title: Airflow Exponential Backoff Policy
text: Production Airflow DAGs should configure retries=3 with retry_exponential_backoff=True and max_retry_delay=timedelta(minutes=30). Use SLA callbacks to alert Slack channels before downstream SLAs breach.

title: Kafka Dead Letter Queue Routing
text: When Avro schema deserialization or business validation fails in a Kafka consumer, route the raw payload, original partition, offset, and stack trace to a dedicated Dead Letter Queue topic instead of blocking consumer group offset commits.

title: Executive Compensation Bands
text: Confidential salary bands for VP and Director tiers are governed under restricted HR access policies. Only hr_admin principals may query compensation metrics.
